title: Closing a waste route and resetting the kit
moduleTitle: Group (Cleaning & Hygiene): Quality, evidence and handover
audience: Cleaners who finish a waste route and prepare the kit for the next visit.
learningOutcomes: Confirm that every full bag has reached its collection point before closing a route.
Return and reset the kit so it is ready for the next visit.
Record shortages and missed areas on the job sheet.

instruction.heading: Finishing is part of the job
instruction.body: A route is not complete until the kit is back in the storage room and set up for next time. Leftover waste, dirty cloths and empty bottles left in corridors create hazards and slow the next shift. Close the route in the same order each time, so nothing is missed.

instruction.heading: Bringing the kit back
instruction.body: Empty the collection bin at the designated point, check that no waste is left inside, and wipe its outside. Return the tote and the tools to storage. Put used cloths into the laundry basket or hang them to dry, as the site rules say.

instruction.heading: Resetting for next time
instruction.body: Refill spray bottles, fit spare liners in each bin on the list, and check that the drop sheet and scoop are present. Note any shortages on the job sheet. A kit that is ready at the start of the route is what makes the next route quick.

procedure: Confirm that every full bag has been placed at the collection point.
Empty and wipe the collection bin.
Return the tote and tools to the storage room.
Place cloths for laundering or hang them to dry, per the site rules.
Refill bottles, restock liners, and check the drop sheet and scoop.
Record shortages and missed areas on the job sheet.

workedExamples.situation: At the end of a route the collection bin still holds a few pieces of waste, and the cloth basket is full.
workedExamples.decisionPrompt: What should be done before the route is marked done?
workedExamples.reasoning: Empty the bin at the collection point before closing the route, then take the used cloths to the laundry basket. If bags were missed on the way, note it on the job sheet so the collection schedule can be checked.

commonErrors.error: Marking the route complete with bags still waiting at the collection point.
commonErrors.prevention: Check every collection point before closing the route.

commonErrors.error: Leaving used cloths lying on the ground or in the collection bin.
commonErrors.prevention: Place used cloths in the laundry basket as soon as the route ends.

commonErrors.error: Forgetting to refill bottles for the next visit.
commonErrors.prevention: Use a reset checklist and tick off each item before leaving the storage room.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: Do not leave bags or wet floors unmarked in walkways at the end of a route.
Store products in their own labelled places, away from food and drink.

qualityStandard: The kit is back in storage and set up for the next visit.
No waste is left at a collection point.
summary: Close a route only when every bag has reached its collection point.
Reset the kit: empty and wipe the bin, launder cloths, refill bottles, restock liners.
Record shortages and missed areas so the next route starts ready.

knowledgeChecks.question: What should happen before a route is marked complete?
options: Every full bag is collected from its collection point
The client signs a receipt for each bin at the door
All spare liners are taken out of storage for the next route

knowledgeChecks.question: Why reset the kit at the end of a route?
options: So the next route can start quickly with supplies ready
So the kit can be sold to another team at once
So the bins can be emptied again the next day

knowledgeChecks.question: What should you do with used cloths at the end of a route?
options: Leave them on the drop sheet until the next route starts
Put them in the laundry basket, or hang them, per site rules
Put them into the waste bag with the rubbish at the end
